_comment: MPL TestServer commons bug-list.json (design 'Bug Configuration'): the
authoritative ledger of known bugs across the MPL Language_Servers, a 'bugs'
object keyed by bug id, each { description, ticketId }. A server declares
the ids it currently exhibits in its own bug-config.json (a flat array);
every such id MUST be defined here. Empty: no known bugs.
